import os
import json
import csv
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# --- 1. DIRECTORY CONFIGURATION ---
DIRS = {
    "ADA": r"C:\Users\vishw\OneDrive\Desktop\Explo\stylegan2-ADA-pytorch\training-runs\00012-panda-mirror-paper256-kimg200-resumecustom",
    "FakeCLR": r"C:\Users\vishw\OneDrive\Desktop\Explo\FakeCLR\merged_snapshots",
    "InsGen": r"C:\Users\vishw\OneDrive\Desktop\Explo\insgen\training-runs\00003-panda-mirror-paper256-kimg200-resumecustom",
    "DANI": r"C:\Users\vishw\OneDrive\Desktop\Explo\DANI\training-runs\00004-stylegan2-panda-gpus1-batch8-d_pos-first-noise_sd-0.5-target0.45-ada_kimg100-brand_new_run_numbered"
}

COLORS = {"ADA": "#1f77b4", "FakeCLR": "#d62728", "InsGen": "#2ca02c", "DANI": "#9467bd"}
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')

# --- 2. PARSING FUNCTIONS ---
def load_metric(base_dir, metric_type):
    variants = {
        'kid': [('kid5k_full', ['kid5k_full']), ('kid50k_full', ['kid50k_full'])],
        'fid': [('fid5k_full', ['fid5k_full']), ('fid50k_full', ['fid50k_full'])],
        'pr':  [('pr5k3_full', ['pr5k3_full_precision', 'pr5k3_full_recall']), 
                ('pr50k3_full', ['pr50k3_full_precision', 'pr50k3_full_recall'])],
        'is':  [('is5k', ['is5k_mean']), ('is50k', ['is50k_mean'])]
    }
    
    data = {}
    for file_name, keys in variants[metric_type]:
        file_path = os.path.join(base_dir, f"metric-{file_name}.jsonl")
        if os.path.exists(file_path):
            with open(file_path, 'rt') as f:
                for line in f:
                    entry = json.loads(line)
                    pkl_name = os.path.basename(entry['snapshot_pkl'])
                    kimg = int(pkl_name.split('-')[-1].split('.')[0])
                    
                    if metric_type == 'kid': data[kimg] = {'score': entry['results'][keys[0]]}
                    if metric_type == 'fid': data[kimg] = {'score': entry['results'][keys[0]]}
                    if metric_type == 'pr':  data[kimg] = {'precision': entry['results'][keys[0]], 'recall': entry['results'][keys[1]]}
                    if metric_type == 'is':  data[kimg] = {'score': entry['results'][keys[0]]}
            return data 
    return data

def load_custom_csv(file_path, value_col):
    data = {}
    if os.path.exists(file_path):
        with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
            reader = csv.DictReader(f)
            for row in reader:
                data[int(row['kimg'])] = {'score': float(row[value_col])}
    return data

def extract_xy(data_dict, key):
    sorted_kimgs = sorted(data_dict.keys())
    return sorted_kimgs, [data_dict[k][key] for k in sorted_kimgs]

# --- 3. LOAD ALL DATA ---
data_store = {}
for name, path in DIRS.items():
    data_store[name] = {
        'kid': load_metric(path, 'kid'),
        'fid': load_metric(path, 'fid'),
        'pr':  load_metric(path, 'pr'),
        'is':  load_metric(path, 'is'),
        'lpips': load_custom_csv(os.path.join(path, "custom_lpips_metrics.csv"), "lpips_avg"),
        'msssim': load_custom_csv(os.path.join(path, "custom_msssim_metrics.csv"), "msssim_avg")
    }
print("data successfully loaded")

# --- THE MASTER PLOT (2x3 GRID) ---
# (Assumes data_store, COLORS, and extract_xy are already loaded in memory)

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(24, 14))
fig.suptitle("Master Architecture Comparison: FFHQ to Panda Transfer Learning", fontsize=24, fontweight='bold', y=1.03)

# Helper for line styles (Dashed for DANI's 50k run to distinguish it)
def get_style(model_name): return '--' if model_name == "DANI" else '-'
def get_label(model_name): return f"{model_name} (50k)" if model_name == "DANI" else model_name

# [0,0] FID
for model, metrics in data_store.items():
    if not metrics['fid']: continue
    x, y = extract_xy(metrics['fid'], 'score')
    axs[0,0].plot(x, y, marker='s', linestyle=get_style(model), linewidth=2.5, color=COLORS[model], label=get_label(model))
axs[0,0].set_title('Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) ↓', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axs[0,0].set_ylabel('Score', fontsize=12)
axs[0,0].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axs[0,0].legend(fontsize=11)

# [0,1] KID
for model, metrics in data_store.items():
    if not metrics['kid']: continue
    x, y = extract_xy(metrics['kid'], 'score')
    axs[0,1].plot(x, y, marker='o', linestyle=get_style(model), linewidth=2.5, color=COLORS[model], label=get_label(model))
axs[0,1].set_title('Kernel Inception Distance (KID) ↓', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axs[0,1].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axs[0,1].legend(fontsize=11)

# [0,2] LPIPS
for model, metrics in data_store.items():
    if not metrics['lpips']: continue
    x, y = extract_xy(metrics['lpips'], 'score')
    axs[0,2].plot(x, y, marker='p', linewidth=2.5, color=COLORS[model], label=model)
axs[0,2].set_title('Pairwise LPIPS (Diversity) ↑', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axs[0,2].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axs[0,2].legend(fontsize=11)

# [1,0] Inception Score (IS)
for model, metrics in data_store.items():
    if not metrics['is']: continue
    x, y = extract_xy(metrics['is'], 'score')
    axs[1,0].plot(x, y, marker='D', linestyle=get_style(model), linewidth=2.5, color=COLORS[model], label=get_label(model))
axs[1,0].set_title('Inception Score (IS) ↑', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axs[1,0].set_xlabel('Training Progress (kimg)', fontsize=12)
axs[1,0].set_ylabel('Score', fontsize=12)
axs[1,0].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axs[1,0].legend(fontsize=11)

# [1,1] Precision & Recall
for model, metrics in data_store.items():
    if not metrics['pr']: continue
    x_p, y_p = extract_xy(metrics['pr'], 'precision')
    x_r, y_r = extract_xy(metrics['pr'], 'recall')
    axs[1,1].plot(x_p, y_p, marker='^', linestyle='-', linewidth=2.5, color=COLORS[model], label=f"{model} (Precision)")
    axs[1,1].plot(x_r, y_r, marker='v', linestyle=':', linewidth=2, alpha=0.7, color=COLORS[model], label=f"{model} (Recall)")
axs[1,1].set_title('Precision & Recall ↑', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axs[1,1].set_xlabel('Training Progress (kimg)', fontsize=12)
axs[1,1].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
# FIX: Moved legend inside, using 2 columns to keep it compact
axs[1,1].legend(fontsize=10, loc='best', ncol=2) 

# [1,2] MS-SSIM
for model, metrics in data_store.items():
    if not metrics['msssim']: continue
    x, y = extract_xy(metrics['msssim'], 'score')
    axs[1,2].plot(x, y, marker='X', linewidth=2.5, color=COLORS[model], label=model)
axs[1,2].set_title('MS-SSIM (Diversity) ↓', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axs[1,2].set_xlabel('Training Progress (kimg)', fontsize=12)
axs[1,2].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axs[1,2].legend(fontsize=11)

# FIX: Explicit padding controls to distribute whitespace evenly
plt.tight_layout(pad=2.0, w_pad=1.5, h_pad=2.0)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display

# --- FINAL METRICS SUMMARY TABLE ---
# (Assumes data_store and extract_xy are already loaded in memory)

table_rows = []

for model_name, metrics in data_store.items():
    # Label DANI appropriately to remember it's the 50k run
    display_name = f"{model_name} (50k)" if model_name == "DANI" else model_name
    row_data = {"Architecture": display_name}
    
    # Helper function to safely extract the last recorded value
    def get_last_val(metric_data, key='score'):
        if metric_data:
            _, y = extract_xy(metric_data, key)
            return f"{y[-1]:.4f}"
        return "N/A"

    # Populate the row
    row_data["FID ↓"] = get_last_val(metrics.get('fid'))
    row_data["KID ↓"] = get_last_val(metrics.get('kid'))
    row_data["Inception Score ↑"] = get_last_val(metrics.get('is'))
    
    # Precision and Recall have specific keys
    if metrics.get('pr'):
        _, p_vals = extract_xy(metrics['pr'], 'precision')
        _, r_vals = extract_xy(metrics['pr'], 'recall')
        row_data["Precision (Fidelity) ↑"] = f"{p_vals[-1]:.4f}"
        row_data["Recall (Diversity) ↑"] = f"{r_vals[-1]:.4f}"
    else:
        row_data["Precision (Fidelity) ↑"] = "N/A"
        row_data["Recall (Diversity) ↑"] = "N/A"
        
    row_data["LPIPS (Diversity) ↑"] = get_last_val(metrics.get('lpips'))
    row_data["MS-SSIM (Diversity) ↓"] = get_last_val(metrics.get('msssim'))
    
    table_rows.append(row_data)

# Create and display the DataFrame
df_summary = pd.DataFrame(table_rows)
df_summary.set_index("Architecture", inplace=True)

# Apply some basic pandas styling for a cleaner look
styled_df = df_summary.style.set_caption("Final Transfer Learning Metric Comparison") \
                            .set_table_styles([{
                                'selector': 'caption',
                                'props': [('font-size', '18px'), ('font-weight', 'bold'), ('color', 'black'), ('margin-bottom', '10px')]
                            }]) \
                            .set_properties(**{'text-align': 'center', 'font-size': '14px', 'padding': '10px'}) \
                            .set_table_attributes('style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;"')

# Render the table
display(styled_df)
